subject: Residential Permit Parking Opt-Out Expansion
overview: The Medford Traffic Commission met to address routine parking variances, senior visitor pass fee structures, school zone designations, and commuter parking allocations. The commission voted down a proposal to expand the residential permit parking pilot program to a half-mile radius around the Green Line extension.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the December 2022 Traffic Commission meeting.

items.title: 2023 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved the public meeting schedule for 2023, establishing regular meetings on the second Tuesday of each month except July and August.

items.title: Absentee Landlord Parking Permits and Visitor Passes
items.summary: Approved allowing non-resident property owners to receive one resident parking permit and one visitor pass per property.

items.title: Parking Variance: 91 Bristol Road
items.summary: Approved a parking variance granting resident permits and two visitor passes for 91 Bristol Road, a split-boundary residence with Somerville frontage in Medford.

items.title: Gaston Street Snow Emergency Parking
items.summary: Tabled to February a petition to restrict snow emergency parking to the odd side only on Gaston Street between Brackett and Taft streets, pending DPW and safety review.

items.title: Parking Variance: 6 Alston Court
items.summary: Tabled a request for a permit parking variance and visitor passes for 6 Alston Court for one month due to the petitioner's absence.

items.title: Senior Visitor Pass Fee Waiver
items.summary: Voted to create a distinct senior visitor parking permit category and recommended to the City Council that passes be issued free of charge to seniors who do not own vehicles.

items.title: Upper City Hall Lot Commuter Parking Spaces
items.summary: Approved designating 23 specific spaces in the Upper City Hall lot on Clippership Drive for mixed-use commuter permit and paid parking.

items.title: Parking Variance: 291–293 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved a formal variance granting parking permits and two visitor passes on Carolina Street for residents of 291–293 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Medford High School Zone Designation
items.summary: Approved establishing a school zone with a 20 mph speed limit on Winthrop Street near Medford High School from Victory Park to Lorain Road.

items.title: Residential Permit Parking Opt-Out Program Expansion
items.summary: Denied a proposal to expand the residential permit parking opt-out pilot to a half-mile radius around the Green Line extension following extensive public opposition.

items.title: Spencer Road Opt-Out Petition
items.summary: Voted to schedule the review of Spencer Road's permit parking opt-out petition as the first item on the February meeting agenda once paperwork is assembled.
